gameDescriptionHtml:
Alchemia is a turn-based strategy roguelike with a hint of puzzle. You’ll collect alchemical reagents, building your own personalized combat satchel, and combine them into magical recipes, unique to each run, to battle against outlandish foes.

Welcome to the land of Alchemia, where magic and alchemy meet to create fantastical creatures and allow a few individuals to harness powers only dreamt of! In your journeys through this land you’ll encounter foes, friends, ancient knowledge and relics from a bygone civilization, and much more!

Game Features

  • 35+ different enemies to strategize against and defeat.
  • 60 unique recipes to discover, with over 10 quintillion possible combinations in each run.
  • 35+ powerful artifacts to loot and customize your build.
  • 20+ detailed events to encounter during journeys.
  • …and much more to discover!
